description: Full details for one My San Felipe Vacation rental in San Felipe, Baja California: description, bedrooms and bed setup, bathrooms, size, capacity, pet policy, amenities, photos, approximate location, house policies (check-in/out, payment, deposit, cancellation) and office contact. Identify the home by property_id or by its name (property_name). Use get_quote for prices.

language.description: Language of the booking link: en (default) or es

property_id.description: The property's ID, from search results

property_name.description: The home's name, e.g. Jerry's Beach Club Condo 4 (use instead of property_id when you don't have the ID)

name: get_property_details
title: Get property details
